tips.text: Recruit through LFG or a clanmate instead of public matchmaking; public squads scatter before a fracture is sealed.
Stage four canisters at a Blink Pad near the fracture, then commit them all at once.
Park Amesha above the canister with Benevolent Decoy stacked three times and recast it when it expires.
Stay at max altitude on Amesha to avoid ground-to-air rockets dismounting you.
Scout the next fracture by Archwing while the current one finishes; Itzal or Hyperion Thrusters speed it up.
Bring Vauban, Frost, Revenant, Atlas, Octavia or Mesa to hold the canister; Limbo works solo but some Vallis enemies ignore the rift.
Bring a status cleanse; the Radiation burp can turn you onto the canister.
Carry a canister in Archwing or as Operator and fast-travel with it; you do not have to drop it.
Do not count on a Resource Booster for points; it raises Diluted Thermia but not event points.
Feed only two canisters per fracture when solo; partial canisters still combine into one Diluted Thermia.
Bring a well-modded primary; one player at low Mastery failed seals with an undermodded one.
Nobody calls this hard; with a team or the Amesha trick it is an afternoon spread over one event.
A coordinated team clears all 100 points in under two hours.
